answer: Follow the incentive: a juror voting with the majority by default earns nothing extra, a juror diverging without evidence loses its bond, and a duplicate submission forfeits the payout instead of splitting it across aliases. That last rule is the only reason a farm of identical answers stops paying. Any identity idle for an epoch sheds standing at a fixed rate, so the opal shine of a big registered count fades without work. No thread connects a clone's vote to a real judgement. The vertex where it all binds is the bond, the one thing the attacker cannot copy.
